note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There were 29 nominations for the 23 seats (Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1); the five divisions polled were Ballyharrigan, Bellarena, Dungiven, Feeny and Owenreagh, where 'All the five outgoing members ... were returned ... in straight fights' (Londonderry Sentinel, 10 June 1964, p. 15). Mr. Marcus Gault was the new member for Lislane, nominated in place of the retiring member. Returned unopposed.
